query: Which incentive or enforcement mechanisms (funder mandates, publisher requirements, procurement rules, accreditation recognition or sanctions) most effectively drive private-sector adoption of standardized ethical review practices?

response.query: Which incentive or enforcement mechanisms (funder mandates, publisher requirements, procurement rules, accreditation recognition or sanctions) most effectively drive private-sector adoption of standardized ethical review practices?
response.answer: Funder mandates and public procurement rules most effectively drive private-sector adoption of standardized ethical review practices. These mechanisms create clear requirements and incentives for compliance.
